metadata.label: Appendix 3 - D3 Scenario
metadata.description:
Comprehensive glycaemic control intervention for people with diabetes to prevent microvascular complications.
This scenario exposes the parameters for both standard and intensive glycaemic control programs that work by maintaining optimal blood glucose levels through medication management and glucose monitoring.
The intervention reduces progression from diabetes to diabetic nephropathy, retinopathy, and other complications by providing systematic glucose control with standard home glucose monitoring for insulin-treated patients.
Standard glycaemic control targets 90% of diabetic patients, while intensive glycaemic control is provided for 10% of patients requiring more aggressive management.
The intervention includes regular blood glucose monitoring, medication adjustment, patient education on diabetes management, and clinical follow-up to maintain target glucose levels.
This intervention is fundamental to diabetes care and provides the foundation for preventing multiple diabetes complications across all organ systems.
Note: This intervention should be implemented alongside other diabetes care interventions for comprehensive management of diabetes complications.
